sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: ScaLAPACK：區塊循環索引與矩陣所有權驗證
related.titleEn: ScaLAPACK: block-cyclic indexing and matrix ownership
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：驗收分開記錄最優性、秩、唯一性與外部資料品質。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Record optimality, rank, uniqueness and external data quality separately.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「ScaLAPACK：區塊循環索引與矩陣所有權驗證」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付兩組所有權圖、九十六元素計數、邊緣區塊與 gather 比對。
related.differenceEn: Investigate ScaLAPACK: block-cyclic indexing and matrix ownership using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver both ownership maps, ninety-six-entry coverage checks, partial-edge-block records and gather comparisons with indexing and process-order conventions preserved.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 代入候選解算三列殘差，求二範數；再算兩個欄與殘差的內積，檢查正交。
i=6、j=10 除區塊二取 floor，得到區塊 (3,5)，再循環到程序 (1,2)。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Substitute the proposed solution, compute all three residuals and their Euclidean norm, then take each column dot product with the residual. This independently checks optimality rather than relying on a reported least-squares status.

Divide i=6 and j=10 by block size two and take floors, obtaining block coordinates (3,5). Cycle these across the process grid, retaining intermediate coordinates so each ownership transformation is auditable.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: openPMD：SI 比例、維度向量與物理時間
related.titleEn: openPMD: SI scaling, dimension vectors and physical time
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：驗收分開記錄最優性、秩、唯一性與外部資料品質。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Record optimality, rank, uniqueness and external data quality separately.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「openPMD：SI 比例、維度向量與物理時間」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付陣列與單位 manifest、SI 轉換、時間對照及重複縮放反例。
related.differenceEn: Investigate openPMD: SI scaling, dimension vectors and physical time using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver array and unit manifests, SI conversions, physical-time mappings and a double-scaling counterexample preserving raw values alongside their interpreted physical quantities.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 代入候選解算三列殘差，求二範數；再算兩個欄與殘差的內積，檢查正交。
儲存值三乘一百萬，保留原值與轉換值兩欄；用除法回復原始三作往返驗證。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Substitute the proposed solution, compute all three residuals and their Euclidean norm, then take each column dot product with the residual. This independently checks optimality rather than relying on a reported least-squares status.

Multiply stored value three by one million, preserving raw and converted columns. Divide the converted value by the same scale to recover three, demonstrating a reversible interpretation rather than overwriting the original dataset.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
